Being a Thoughtful Guest

For anyone who wants to feel more at ease visiting other people's homes, from a family dinner to a weekend stay. Each day is one small way to arrive kindly, help a little, respect the household and leave a warm thank you behind.

Connection · Relationships · Communication · Social Anxiety · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Picture a home where you once felt welcome, and name one small thing the host did that put you at ease.
  • Day 2Smile and say a warm hello to your host the moment the door opens, even before you take off your coat.
  • Day 3Think of one small chore you enjoy, like drying dishes, so you have a ready offer at your next visit.
  • Day 4Before you pack, send your host a short note saying how much you are looking forward to the stay.
  • Day 5Remember a goodbye that left you feeling warm, and think about what the person said.
  • Day 6Reply to an invitation sitting in your messages today, even if your answer is simply "Yes, thank you, I would love to come."
  • Day 7Hand your host anything you brought straight away, with a simple "This is for you."

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Ask your host, "Can I help wash a few dishes before I go?" and accept a no with a smile.
  • Day 60Send a short thank you text to your host before you go to sleep tonight.
  • Day 120Sign your host's guest book with a few warm words, if they keep one, before you leave.
  • Day 240Bring an empty bag along so you can carry your own dish home after a potluck without fuss.
  • Day 365Appreciate yourself for showing up, helping out and saying thank you, whether the visit felt smooth or a bit bumpy.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
